topic: Reflection of Light and Image Formation
key_concepts: Reflection occurs when light bounces off surfaces
Smooth shiny surfaces produce clear images
Rough or crumpled surfaces produce distorted or unclear images
Different reflecting surfaces produce different image characteristics
The angle of incidence is measured between the incident ray and the normal line
The angle of reflection is measured between the reflected ray and the normal line
The law of reflection states that the angle of incidence equals the angle of reflection
A ray striking along the normal line has zero angle of incidence and reflection
Plane mirror images are virtual, upright, and same size as the object
Image location is found by extending reflected rays behind the mirror
